tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background; the warm off-white ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs lifted off surface; separate with line, not shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface or surface-raised (16:1); also dark slabs and code blocks.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface (5.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers (1px). Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links and focus rings; text in brand on surface passes 5.5:1. Text on brand fills uses surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlights, data emphasis and the one thing to notice. A fill only: put ink on it, never use it as text on surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; text on surface passes 5.3:1. Pair with an icon or label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; between related lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; default gap between elements.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections and page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, dialogs and hero blocks.
